### Quickest possible start

```bash
pip install geoai-datacubes
```

Or open the [grand tour notebook](https://colab.research.google.com/github/buckai-observatory/geoai-datacubes/blob/main/notebooks/00_geoai_datacubes_tour.ipynb) in Colab — the first cell installs the package for you.
:::

## What this is

`geoai-datacubes` is the [BuckAI Observatory](https://buckai-observatory.org)'s data-preparation front-end for Earth-observation machine learning. It unifies **26 satellite missions and derived products** behind a single configuration-driven pipeline: you specify a region, a time window, and a set of bands; it fetches the imagery from whichever provider is fastest, co-registers everything onto a common UTM grid, applies per-band normalisation from a declarative metadata registry, and hands you a multi-band GeoTIFF or Zarr cube that a PyTorch `Dataset` can stream training tiles from without ever materialising them to disk.

The library exists because the bottleneck in most satellite-ML research isn't the model — it's the data-preparation pipeline. Foundation-model wrappers are one `pip install` away; a working multi-mission fetch + fusion + normalisation + spatially-aware-split pipeline is not.

## Citing

If you use `geoai-datacubes` in your research, please cite the archived software artifact:

```bibtex
@software{moortgat_geoai_datacubes_2026,
  author       = {Moortgat, Joachim and Jain, Bhavika and Radhakrishnan, Aswathnarayan and Chowdhury, Satyaki Roy and Hsu, Hsiao Jou},
  title        = {{geoai-datacubes}: AI-ready multi-mission satellite data cubes for {E}arth-observation machine learning},
  year         = 2026,
  publisher    = {Zenodo},
  doi          = {10.5281/zenodo.20829119}
}
```

A software paper is currently [under review](https://joss.theoj.org/papers/41c1ac5fdbfc1a4a4ee3b79cd8e4ee00) at the *Journal of Open Source Software* — this page will link to the accepted paper once published.

## About

Built by the [BuckAI Observatory](https://buckai-observatory.org) at The Ohio State University. Companion resources:

- 🖥️ [**BuckAI HPC Handbook**](https://buckai-observatory.org/buckai-hpc-handbook/) — using OSU's Unity cluster.
- 📖 [**BuckAI Open-Source Handbook**](https://buckai-observatory.org/buckai-open-source-handbook/) — walk-through for taking research code to a citable, installable, peer-reviewed package.

Suggestions, corrections, and pull requests are welcome — file an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/buckai-observatory/geoai-datacubes/issues).
